oportunidades.pt: ETFs 2x long e 2x short de Anthropic comecam a negociar na segunda - a mesma empresa que ja existe tokenizada e negocia no fim de semana. Melhor gancho Fluxion do dia: acesso x calendario.

opcoes.a: long and short the same company at 2x. the market finally found a way to bet against yourself
opcoes.b: etf starts trading monday 9:30. the tokenized version has been trading since friday night. a listing is not a market, access is
opcoes.c: two etfs, opposite directions, same underlying, both charging a fee. beautiful business model ngl

oportunidades.pt: Abraxas Capital comprou mais de US$ 1 bi em BTC com o preco abaixo de US$ 60 mil e tirou 17.597 BTC (US$ 1,04 bi) da Binance e da Kraken. Numero grande com fonte primaria.

opcoes.a: buying the dip with a billion is just the dip with extra steps
opcoes.b: $1.04B in one clip and no desk had to be called. routing that size without slippage is the product - atomic rfq is why it looks quiet
opcoes.c: everyone says they buy red candles. one fund actually did it with 17,597 coins

oportunidades.pt: Democrata ameaca cortar funding federal da SpaceX (US$SPCX). Risco politico caindo de madrugada, alcance alto (3,2 mil lk) e assunto que a mesa ainda nao usou.

opcoes.a: cutting funding to the company that launches the things the government needs. bold strategy
opcoes.b: policy risk lands at 2am and the price has to form somewhere. onchain the gap forms in public, in real time
opcoes.c: one headline and a whole asset class repriced. the rocket is still the fastest thing here tho

oportunidades.pt: Carteira comprou 9.677 ETH a US$ 2.239 ha 2 semanas, esta US$ 5,36 mi no prejuizo e vendeu 3.700 ETH (US$ 6,11 mi) ha 5 horas para cortar perda. Historia de saida, nao de entrada.

opcoes.a: bought the top, sold the bottom, posted the receipt. a full arc
opcoes.b: entry gets all the attention. the exit is where depth actually shows - the ticker is just the address
opcoes.c: down $5.36M in two weeks and still sold into it. respect the discipline, question the entry

oportunidades.pt: Mantle entra no Pumpfun com Callout Rewards para tokens do ecossistema. Noticia de parceiro, engajamento baixo - bom para apoiar sem parecer promocao.

opcoes.a: pumpfun on mantle: the timeline gets a new casino floor
opcoes.b: new front end, same job underneath: pools deep enough that a phone app feels instant. gud to see the ecosystem widen
opcoes.c: callout rewards for talking about tokens. we used to call that a group chat
